acquisition: Two matched nominal conditions N15_M07_F10 and N09_M07_F10, all20 named four-second repeats per condition. Training includes both conditions for six healthy references plus eleven artificial damages. Each of 14 distinct accelerated-life units contributes only high-speed acceleration and RPM to the forecast. Low-speed acceleration, RPM and other sensors are never decoded by the predictor. Independent score uses low-speed acceleration and RPM after a hash lock for every role and unit. Do not treat temporal windows as independent. Exact duplicates, if present, remain with released weights, and are reported.

candidate_identity: At each (C,o), h_l=o*15/2 and h_h=o*n_hi/2. Correct mixed-center source magnitude by sqrt(P_lo(C-h_l)*P_lo(C+h_l)/(P_hi(C-h_h)*P_hi(C+h_h))), using healthy mean ordinary spectra at each speed. Apply identical floor 1e-6 times mean healthy high PSD to each factor. Candidate predicts spectral-density magnitudes in recorded squared acceleration units per Hz. Healthy changes can reflect forcing, receiver and apparatus jointly. Multiplicative LTI identity is only a motivating model. Coherence is not the endpoint.

score: Equal 14 physical bearing units; per unit mean squared error over every common cell divided by the source high-speed surface mean squared amplitude on that exact grid. Candidate must strictly beat every16 other role macromean AND strictly win at least8 of14 against each. Report all roles, each bearing, each run-input digest, target means/rpms, absolute RMS and worst raw cell per bearing. Publish trained roles even if candidate loses. No post-opening model selection.
